name: Qonto
description: Qonto — French business account for SMBs and freelancers: organization and bank accounts, transactions, client and supplier invoices, clients and quotes. Official Business API v2, read-only, login:secret-key API key. 7 tools.
instructions:
This connector reads your **Qonto** business account through the official Business API: organization and bank accounts, transactions, client invoices, supplier invoices, clients and quotes. It is **read-only**: every tool is a GET, so it cannot send transfers, add beneficiaries, touch cards or create, edit or delete invoices.

**Getting the credentials**
1. Sign in to the Qonto web app (https://app.qonto.com) and, if you have several organizations, pick the one to connect.
2. Open **Integrations & Partnerships → API key** and click **Generate** if no secret key exists yet.
3. Put the **login** (sign-in, e.g. `pied-piper-7132`) in `QONTO_LOGIN` and the **secret key** in `QONTO_SECRET_KEY`.

**How authentication works**: Qonto expects `Authorization: <login>:<secret-key>`. This looks like HTTP Basic but is not: no Base64 and no `Bearer` prefix. A 401 almost always means a wrong login or secret.

**Bank data is sensitive.** The connector sees every bank account of the organization. Assign it only to MCP servers whose users are allowed to see the company's bank accounts and transactions.

**Workflow**: call `qonto_get_organization` first to get the bank account `id` (or IBAN); `qonto_list_transactions` lists one account at a time; passing `bank_account_id` or `iban` is recommended (whether Qonto rejects a call without them is pending verification).

**Pagination**: list tools take `page` and `per_page` (1 to 100, default 100); responses carry `meta.next_page` and `meta.total_pages`.

**Amounts**: transactions expose `amount` and `amount_cents`; prefer the cents for arithmetic.

**Unverified.** This adapter has not been exercised against a live Qonto account yet. Two points still need confirming with a real account: the exact `Authorization: <login>:<secret-key>` header format, and whether `/transactions` requires `bank_account_id` or `iban`. A correction from anyone running it against a real organization is welcome.

**Sandbox**: create an application on the Qonto Developer Portal (https://developers.qonto.com) to get a sandbox organization and a personal staging token. After install, edit the connector: set the base URL to `https://thirdparty-sandbox.staging.qonto.co/v2` and add the header `X-Qonto-Staging-Token: <your token>` (case-sensitive). Without it, sandbox calls return a OneLogin HTML page instead of JSON. The staging token is not accepted in production.

**Cloud reachability**: thirdparty.qonto.com is public with a valid certificate.

tools.name: qonto_get_organization
tools.description: Get the Qonto organization: legal name, slug and every bank account with its id, IBAN, BIC, currency, balance and status. Call this first: qonto_list_transactions needs a bank account id or IBAN from here.

tools.name: qonto_list_transactions
tools.description: List transactions of one bank account. Pass bank_account_id or iban (recommended; call qonto_get_organization first to get them, a call without them is pending verification). Without a status filter Qonto returns only completed transactions. Filter by date range, side, status and operation type; paginated.

bank_account_id.description: Bank account id from qonto_get_organization. Takes precedence over iban when both are set.

iban.description: IBAN of the bank account, from qonto_get_organization.

settled_at_from.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; only transactions settled at or after it.

settled_at_to.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; only transactions settled at or before it.

emitted_at_from.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; only transactions emitted at or after it.

emitted_at_to.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; only transactions emitted at or before it.

status.description: One status per call: pending, declined, completed or reversed (sent as status[]). When omitted, Qonto returns only completed transactions, so set it to see pending or declined ones.

operation_type.description: Operation type, e.g. card, transfer, direct_debit, income (sent as operation_type[]).

with_attachments.description: true to keep only transactions with attachments, false for those without.

tools.name: qonto_get_transaction
tools.description: Get one transaction by its id: amount, currency, side, counterparty, label, status, operation type, dates, category and attachment ids. Use ids returned by qonto_list_transactions.

tools.name: qonto_list_client_invoices
tools.description: List the client invoices the organization issued from Qonto, filtered by status and by due date, creation or update date ranges. Answers questions like unpaid invoices due this week.

status.description: Invoice status, e.g. draft, unpaid, paid, canceled (filter[status]).

due_date_from.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD; due on or after (filter[due_date_from]).

due_date_to.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD; due on or before (filter[due_date_to]).

tools.name: qonto_list_supplier_invoices
tools.description: List supplier invoices received in Qonto, filtered by status, creation date and a free-text query over the fields named in query_fields. Useful to find bills to review or pay, or missing documents.

status.description: Supplier invoice status, e.g. to_review, to_approve, awaiting_payment, pending, paid (filter[status]). to_pay is deprecated by Qonto; use to_review.

query.description: Free-text search; Qonto applies it to the fields listed in query_fields.

query_fields.description: Comma-separated fields searched by query, e.g. supplier_name,amount,file_name,invoice_number.

tools.name: qonto_list_clients
tools.description: List the clients (customers) in the Qonto invoicing address book, optionally filtered by name, VAT number or email. Returns ids, contact data and billing addresses.

tools.name: qonto_list_quotes
tools.description: List the quotes (devis) created in Qonto, filtered by status and creation date range, with client, amounts, validity and status. Read-only: it cannot create or send quotes.

status.description: Quote status, e.g. pending_approval, approved, canceled (filter[status]).
